id.description: The id of the Sim Action to run when creating the job.

name.description: The name to give the new bulk job.

source_actor_tags.description: Comma separated list of source actors by id.

destination_actor_tags.description: Comma separated list of destination actors by id.

tag_combination_strategy.description: Determines how actors are lookedup. 'OR' - any actor with at least one of the tags. 'AND' - any actor with all of the tags.

action_user_profile_id.description: Action user profile to use when running the job.

run_time_params.description: If supplied, must be of the form 'run_time_params[1][key1]=value1&run_time_params[1][key2]=value2'. Only run_time_params[1]... will be included. Anything starting with run_time_params[2]... etc., will be ignored.

items.description: Hash of runtime params set when running the job.
